title: Weather in Sydney – Tourism Australia
facts: Sydney summer is December to February; autumn is March to May; winter is June to August; spring is September to November.
Tourism Australia describes autumn as mild with lower humidity and suitable for coastal walks; spring is warmer with less humidity than summer.
Winter is cooler, and Tourism Australia reports that rainfall is generally highest in June.
notes: Seasonal planning facts read from the official source. No exact forecast or operational guarantee.
